en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ali Bin Hassan, from the one who narrated it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘How ugly it would be with the Momin if there happens to be a desire for him which disgraces him’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Ali ibn Hassan from those who narrated to him from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
How disgraceful to a believer is a desire that humiliates him!”’
